title: When the Postcards Sings
author: Xanthe Lockridge
blurb: Theo Sterling, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
